source_processing: The existing repository-ingested public dataset rescales ice_conc by 0.01 and provides status flags used to derive fixed active/ocean masks from training dates only. No new external data request was made.
region_selection: 64x64 original-grid patch centred on the grid point nearest 78N,25E, selected before running either model
checkpoint_rule: Fixed final checkpoint, no selection on test or validation scores
encoder_decoder: Fixed affine encoding/decoding using training-only mean and standard deviation, not a pretrained production encoder
loss: MSE of v-prediction over the same fixed active ocean mask
spatial_scope: One 1600 km square crop, not a pan-Arctic operational evaluation
